title: Charak Samhita New Edition
author: Traditional attribution (Agnivesha, redacted by Charaka, completed by Dridhabala)
translator: Singh R.H., Singh G., Sodhi J.S., Dixit U. (and other contributors)
publisher: Charak Samhita Research, Training and Skill Development Centre (CCRAS/NIIMH)
provenance: Academic project by CCRAS/NIIMH, Government of India. 135 contributors. DOIs assigned per chapter.
description: Definitive online edition of Ayurveda's core treatise. Contains original Sanskrit text with diacritics, transliteration, English translation, and scholarly commentary (Tattva Vimarsha, Vidhi Vimarsha). 805 articles covering all 8 sthanas (sections).
